form_analysis.feedback: Exceptional laser-specific aftercare for periorbital tightening with detailed guidance on this ultra-delicate area. Comprehensive swelling management protocols and realistic expectations about different eye concerns. Strong emphasis on the extended timeline for eyelid results.

form_data.introduction: This aftercare is for fractional laser tightening of the periorbital area (eyelids, crow's feet, under eyes). The eye area has the thinnest skin (0.5mm on eyelids) requiring ultra-conservative laser settings. Specialized eye shields are used during treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Follow for 10-14 days with extreme gentleness. The eyes show swelling dramatically and require meticulous care.

sections.title: Laser Eye Mechanism & Safety
sections.content: Low-energy, low-density fractional laser with specific eye shields protecting globes. Treats: 1) Upper lids for hooding 2) Crow's feet for wrinkles 3) Lower lids for bags/fine lines. Very conservative settings to avoid complications.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Laser Eye Response
items: Significant eyelid swelling (may partially close eyes) for 2-4 days.
Black eyes/bruising in 20-40% of patients.
Tearing, light sensitivity for 24-48 hours.
Tightness when blinking or looking up/down.

sections.title: Periorbital Swelling Management
items: Sleep elevated on 2-3 pillows for 5-7 nights.
Cold compresses: 10 minutes on, 20 off for first 72 hours.
Avoid salt, alcohol, histamine-rich foods for 4 days.
Lymphatic massage: From inner eye outward toward temples.
Consider oral arnica, bromelain, vitamin K.

sections.title: Eye-Specific Aftercare
items: Use preservative-free artificial tears 4-6x daily if dry.
Eye creams ONLY (no face products) after 1 week.
Pat gently, never rub.
Wear sunglasses outdoors for 2 weeks.
Avoid eye makeup for 5-7 days.

sections.title: Makeup & Contact Lens Guidance
items: No contact lenses for 48-72 hours.
When resuming makeup: Use clean brushes, replace mascara.
Avoid waterproof makeup (requires aggressive removal).
Green color corrector neutralizes redness/bruising.

sections.title: Different Eye Concern Timelines
items: Crow's feet: Improvement in 2-4 weeks.
Eyelid hooding: Gradual lift over 2-4 months.
Under eye: Swelling improves in 1-2 weeks, true tightening in 3-4 months.
Fine lines: Texture improvement in 4-8 weeks.

sections.title: Realistic Laser Eye Expectations
items: 1-2mm eyelid lift (mild ptosis improvement).
30-50% reduction in crow's feet depth.
Reduction in under eye puffiness/bags.
Subtle improvement, not dramatic surgical change.
3-5 sessions needed for periorbital area.
Maintenance: Annual touch-ups.

sections.title: Safety & Contraindications
sections.content: Report immediately: Vision changes, severe pain, excessive discharge, or asymmetric swelling. Avoid if: Recent eye surgery, active eye infection, severe dry eye, or history of keloids on eyelids.
